color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no twist. Light register: pageBackground #ffffff (luminance 255). Apple palette: white background, primary blue #0071e3, red #e30000, yellow #ffe045, near-black text #1d1d1f.

type-system.twistDescription: Brutalist transformation: Anton 400 (all-caps geometric condensed) at 160px h1 / 100px h2 — raw poster scale. Space Mono 400 at 14px for all body/UI text — monospace terminal aesthetic. Line-height 1.0 for all headings — zero breathing room. Zero letter-spacing. 11× size differential between display and body. Both Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Zero Motion: ALL transition durations set to 0s. Easing replaced with step-start — binary state change. No keyframe animations. No entrance animations. No scroll-triggered choreography. Global CSS override: * { transition-duration: 0s !important; animation-duration: 0s !important; }. Anti-animation as ideology.

grid-system.twistDescription: Newspaper broadsheet: 6 equal columns, 16px tight gutters, 16px container padding. Brutal utilities: .brutal-divider (2px border-top), .brutal-rule (2px border-left), .brutal-full (span all 6), .brutal-half (span 3), .brutal-third (span 2), .brutal-two-thirds (span 4). Maximum information density.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Raw Compression: 4px base unit. Section padding collapsed to 24px/16px. Button/CTA: 4px/8px (form-input scale). Gaps: 12px newspaper gutters. Border-radius: 0px on all elements. Content touches edges — pure brutalist density.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Brutal instant state flips: all transitions 0s. Hover triggers instant color inversion (black fill, white text). Active state: red flash (#e30000) for ghost buttons. Focus rings: 3px solid black, zero offset. Zero motion coherence throughout.

nav-system.twistDescription: Brutal masthead bar: 80px height, 8px solid #1d1d1f bottom border. Anton all-caps at 1rem/0.05em tracking — declaration, not menu. Fixed, never changes on scroll. Instant hover inversion. Check C PASS: Anton is in assembled type system.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Shifted from premium-aesthetic finesse to raw, confrontational anti-aesthetics. Removed all references to 'elegant,' 'cinematic,' 'atmospheric.' Rewritten for a brutalist editorial/tech platform. Concept: open-source developer tools collective or design criticism platform. 3 documentary video placements: editorial-process.mp4 (20–30s), typographic-specimen.mp4 (15–20s), platform-in-use.mp4 (30–60s).

A_colorContrast.notes: navText #1d1d1f (brightness ~30) vs navBackground #ffffff (brightness 255) — maximum contrast. bodyText #1d1d1f vs pageBackground #ffffff — maximum contrast.

B_motionInteractionCoherence.notes: All interaction transitions 0s. Motion system = Zero Motion (0s, step-start). Perfect coherence — no ratio mismatch possible.

C_navFontAvailability.notes: nav.json fontFamily 'Anton', sans-serif is present in assembled type system (ds-type-display-font-family: 'Anton', sans-serif). No fix needed.
